sections.title: Employment Contract
sections.text:
Noir Corne, Defender Operator of Rhodes Island, will provide a solid defense for the squad.

You can see him cleaning his mask carefully every day.

sections.title: Token
sections.text: A timeworn mask used during sacrificial festivals. The hollow eye sockets bore witness to the birth of the land.

sections.title: Profile
sections.text: One of Rhodes Island's core Operators. On the battlefield, he rushes to the vanguard to protect his teammates, but back at the Ark, he quietly dedicates himself to logistical duties.

sections.title: Clinical Analysis
sections.text:
Radiological scan showed blurred outlines of internal organs with visible abnormalities. Originium Particle Test of circulation system indicated Oripathy. The subject is confirmed to be infected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 11%
No major infection symptoms have yet appeared.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.22u/L
Severity of infection remains low, with no major hindrance on motor functions.

sections.title: Archive File 1
sections.text: A veteran Operator of Rhodes Island in both age and experience, Noir Corne's habit of wearing a mask often makes him seem unapproachable. However, those who converse with him quickly find that he is an easygoing, brotherly figure who gets along well with his juniors and never touts his seniority.

sections.title: Archive File 2
sections.text:
Noir Corne keeps a huge collection of masks in his room. He'll wear the most suitable mask for each occasion.
The mask he is seen with most frequently also seems to be his favorite. In his own words, 'This one best suits Rhodes Island's ambience.'
By the way, his mask does not hide any terrible secrets.

sections.title: Archive File 3
sections.text:
The most peculiar thing about Noir Corne's personality is his caution around Yato - not fear, but a conspicuous, careful deference so as to avoid angering her - which has spawned plenty of gossip among the operators.
However, neither their backgrounds nor their interactions seem to clarify why.
